To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the RIASEC circle is not a normative structure for the sample of students in our study.
the RIASEC model is not an adequate representation of the interests of the students in the study.

(a) individuals who deviate from the normative RIASEC structure are less career certain, (b) individuals who deviated from the normative circular RIASC structure were more career indecisive, and (c) individuals with a wider range of interests and greater deviations from the normative model were more career indeisive.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the structure of interests and how it relates to the career decision-making processes of individuals.
how the structure of vocational interests can be used to predict career indecision and career certainty.
the extent to which individuals’ interest patterns are consistent with Holland’s RIASEC model.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
there are no definitive conclusions about the structure of vocational interest.
the structure of interests is not a hexagon.
the RIASEC hexagonal structure of vocational interests is a valid representation of the interests of the general population, but that the structure of interests is not universal.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
there is evidence for the validity of Holland’s RIASEC model, but that the model is not the only way to organize interests and may not be the best way to organize interests for everyone.
there are many ways that people can be interested in the same things.
the structure of interests is not as rigid or fixed as the Holland model would suggest and that individuals may deviate from the normative model in a number of different ways.
The main takeaway from our work is that
there is a lot of variability in how people organize their interests, and that this variability is related to career outcomes.
people’s interest patterns do not always fit the normative structure, and this is associated with less career decision certainty and more career decision indecision.
people are not always best served by the normative structures that have been created by the field.
